task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! First of all, you could, like, travel east. That done, lift the passkey from the floor of the office. And if you do that, you're the winner!
description:
You arrive in a parlor. A typical one. The room seems oddly familiar, as though it were only superficially different from the other rooms in the building.



There is an unguarded exit to the east. There is an unguarded exit to the north.

thought: The task instructs me to travel east first, so I will go east.
feedback:
You arrive in an office. A standard one.



You need an unblocked exit? You should try going east. There is an unblocked exit to the north. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unguarded.

There is a stick of butter and a passkey on the floor.
